title: The Mossy Threshold
description: A rusted iron gate groans open into a damp stone vestibule. A skeletal sentry rattles to life, blocking the archway.

fight.label: Smash the skeleton with your weapon
fight.outcomeText: You shatter its ribcage in one clean strike! A few silver coins spill from its pouch.

sneak.label: Slip past along the shadowed wall
sneak.outcomeText: You hug the moss-slicked stones and glide past unnoticed.

bargain.label: Toss it a shiny button as a toll
bargain.outcomeText: The skeleton inspects the button, nods solemnly, and hands you a tarnished key.

title: Goblin Tollbooth
description: Two wiry goblins have set up a makeshift wooden barricade across a narrow bridge over a dark chasm.

fight.label: Charge the barricade
fight.outcomeText: They scatter in panic, though one nicks your arm with a rusty fork. You loot their toll jar!

sneak.label: Shimmy underneath the bridge
sneak.outcomeText: You swing across the rafters below while they argue over mushroom soup.

bargain.label: Pay the 10g toll and ask for tips
bargain.outcomeText: The goblins pocket your gold and toss you a slightly chewed healing herb.

title: The Whispering Well
description: An ancient stone well glows with pale cyan light. Faint voices echo from the depths, asking for an offering.

fight.label: Drop a lit torch down the shaft
fight.outcomeText: A shriek erupts from below! Hot steam blasts your face, but a ruby pops onto the rim.

sneak.label: Quietly siphon the glowing water
sneak.outcomeText: You fill a vial with luminescent water without waking whatever sleeps below.

bargain.label: Drop 5 gold into the well
bargain.outcomeText: The whispers turn into a warm chorus, mending your wounds.

title: Alchemist's Ruined Lab
description: Shattered glassware litters the floor. A giant mutated rat guards a bubbling cauldron of violet brew.

fight.label: Slay the mutated rat
fight.outcomeText: The rat bites hard before you pin it down. You claim a potion from the shelf.

sneak.label: Swipe a vial while it sniffs a cheese crust
sneak.outcomeText: Clean heist! You pocket a mysterious elixir and slip out.

bargain.label: Offer it your rations in trade
bargain.outcomeText: The surprisingly polite rat pushes a velvet pouch of coins toward you.

title: The Mimic's Parlor
description: A plush velvet armchair sits beside an ornate treasure chest. Wait—did the chest just blink?

fight.label: Strike the chest before it lunges
fight.outcomeText: It snaps its wooden jaws! You pry it open after a brutal tussle and grab the hoard.

sneak.label: Tip-toe around the rug
sneak.outcomeText: You leave the suspicious chest alone and pocket a stray coin on the mantle.

bargain.label: Compliment its mahogany finish
bargain.outcomeText: Flattered, the mimic purrs like a cat and spits out a shiny ring.

title: Spider Silk Gallery
description: Thick silver webs drape from ceiling to floor. A diamond glints at the center of the largest web.

fight.label: Burn the webs and slash the broodmother
fight.outcomeText: Venomous fangs graze your shoulder, but you claim the diamond!

sneak.label: Cut a single strand and pluck the gem
sneak.outcomeText: Your steady hands barely vibrate the silk. You escape with the prize!

bargain.label: Trade a shiny trinket for safe passage
bargain.outcomeText: The spider tilts its eight eyes, accepts the coin, and lowers a silk ladder.

title: Crypt of the Sleeping Knight
description: A marble sarcophagus lies open. The spectral knight atop it polishes an ethereal greatsword.

fight.label: Challenge the knight to a duel
fight.outcomeText: His ghostly blade chills your bones, but he yields and bestows his crest.

sneak.label: Loot the side-altar while his back is turned
sneak.outcomeText: You scoop up ancient funerary coins without a sound.

bargain.label: Kneel and pledge honor to his order
bargain.outcomeText: The knight's spirit glows warmly, blessing your party with vigor.

title: The Lava Forge
description: Heat radiates from a magma trench. A horned smith hammers a glowing blade on an obsidian anvil.

fight.label: Ambush the smith at the anvil
fight.outcomeText: Sparks fly! You take a burn but seize a pouch of fire-opals.

sneak.label: Cool your boots and cross the catwalk
sneak.outcomeText: You endure the blistering air and slip past the forge.

bargain.label: Pay 15g to sharpen your weapons
bargain.outcomeText: The smith grins and tempers your gear with dragon-ash.

title: Mushroom Grotto
description: Bioluminescent fungi illuminate a humid cavern. Giant toads croak in rhythmic harmony.

fight.label: Slice through the spore-caps
fight.outcomeText: Toxic spores burst in your face! You cough violently but find truffles.

sneak.label: Forage only the safe blue caps
sneak.outcomeText: You gather soothing moss and slip out before the toads notice.

bargain.label: Hum along with the toad chorus
bargain.outcomeText: The toads croak approvingly and spit up a gleaming pearl.

title: The Clockwork Vault
description: Brass gears turn in the walls. A ticking automaton guards a locked vault door.

fight.label: Smash its main gear
fight.outcomeText: Electric arcs zap your hands, but the automaton collapses and the vault pops open!

sneak.label: Pick the lock between gear-ticks
sneak.outcomeText: Click! You time the pendulum perfectly and grab a brass compass.

bargain.label: Feed it a drop of oil and 5g
bargain.outcomeText: It whirs happily and dispenses a handful ofminted tokens.

title: Cursed Mirror Hall
description: Dozens of gilded mirrors line the corridor. Your reflection grins back—a second too late.

fight.label: Shatter the grinning mirror
fight.outcomeText: Glass shards slice your arms, but a shadow-gem clatters to the floor.

sneak.label: Walk backward with eyes closed
sneak.outcomeText: You navigate by touch and emerge unscathed.

bargain.label: Ask your reflection for advice
bargain.outcomeText: It whispers a shortcut and hands you a luck charm through the glass.

title: The Bone Tavern
description: A spectral bartender polishes a skull mug. Undead patrons clink tankards in silent revelry.

fight.label: Start a barroom brawl
fight.outcomeText: Chairs fly! You take a beating but swipe the tip jar.

sneak.label: Swipe a roasted leg of... something
sneak.outcomeText: You snag a hearty meal from the kitchen pass and bolt.

bargain.label: Buy a round for the dead (12g)
bargain.outcomeText: The ghosts cheer! They restore your spirits and gift you a lucky die.

title: Frozen Ossuary
description: Icicles hang like daggers. Frost-wraiths drift between frozen pillars.

fight.label: Shatter the frost-wraiths
fight.outcomeText: Frostbite numbs your fingers, but you claim their icy core.

sneak.label: Slide silently across the ice
sneak.outcomeText: You glide past the wraiths like a shadow.

bargain.label: Share warmth from your torch
bargain.outcomeText: A wraith sighs in gratitude and melts a path to a hidden stash.

title: The Gargoyle Perch
description: A stone gargoyle crouches above a crumbling balcony. Its eyes flicker with lightning.

fight.label: Topple the gargoyle off the ledge
fight.outcomeText: It claws your armor before plunging into the abyss. You loot its nest.

sneak.label: Crawl beneath its line of sight
sneak.outcomeText: You inch past while thunder masks your footsteps.

bargain.label: Offer it a shiny coin for its nest
bargain.outcomeText: The gargoyle nods and drops a gleaming feather-charm.

title: Submerged Catacombs
description: Waist-deep black water floods this hallway. Something scaly ripples beneath the surface.

fight.label: Harpoon the lurker in the dark
fight.outcomeText: A blind cave-gator thrashes! You win, bruised and soaked, with a pearl.

sneak.label: Wade slowly without making ripples
sneak.outcomeText: You cross the flooded hall without disturbing the water.

bargain.label: Toss a piece of jerky to distract it
bargain.outcomeText: It snaps up the snack and nudges a sunken chest toward you.

title: The Librarian's Study
description: Towering bookshelves lean precariously. A giant horned owl peers at you over spectacles.

fight.label: Snatch the glowing tome by force
fight.outcomeText: The owl shrieks and talons your face, but you grab the tome!

sneak.label: Borrow a scroll while it preens
sneak.outcomeText: You slip a healing scroll into your pack.

bargain.label: Return an overdue bookmark (5g)
bargain.outcomeText: The owl hoots with delight and stamps your hand with a ward.

title: Trapdoor Gauntlet
description: Swinging pendulums and pressure plates guard a narrow stone causeway.

fight.label: Jam the gears with your weapon
fight.outcomeText: A blade grazes your ribs, but the trap halts and reveals a hidden stash.

sneak.label: Dash through the rhythm
sneak.outcomeText: Pure agility! You clear the gauntlet without a scratch.

bargain.label: Pay a passing kobold trap-setter (10g)
bargain.outcomeText: He pulls a hidden lever, disabling every blade.

title: The Dragon's Nursery
description: Three warm dragon eggs nestle in a pile of gold. A wyrmling naps nearby, snoring smoke.

fight.label: Slay the wyrmling and loot the nest
fight.outcomeText: Fiery breath scorches your cloak, but the gold pile is yours!

sneak.label: Pocket a handful of coins quietly
sneak.outcomeText: You tiptoe out with warm gold before the wyrmling wakes.

bargain.label: Scratch behind its scaly ears
bargain.outcomeText: It purrs like a furnace and nudges a dragonscale into your hand.

title: Shadow Market
description: Hooded figures trade contraband by purple lantern light. A merchant beckons you over.

fight.label: Rob the merchant's stall
fight.outcomeText: Bodyguards jump you! You escape battered with a handful of gems.

sneak.label: Pickpocket a distracted noble
sneak.outcomeText: Smooth fingers! You lift a fat coin purse.

bargain.label: Buy a mystery bundle (15g)
bargain.outcomeText: Inside is a potent healing draught and a silver charm!

title: The Blood Altar
description: A crimson obelisk pulses like a heartbeat. Dark energy crackles around a golden chalice.

fight.label: Shatter the obelisk
fight.outcomeText: A shockwave knocks you back, but the chalice rolls to your feet!

sneak.label: Swap the chalice with a stone
sneak.outcomeText: Classic swap! The altar doesn't notice.

bargain.label: Offer a drop of blood for power
bargain.outcomeText: It stings, but dark gold materializes in your pouch.

title: Crystal Cavern
description: Prism-like crystals refract your torchlight into rainbows. Bat-winged imps chatter above.

fight.label: Swat the imps and mine the wall
fight.outcomeText: They nip your ears, but you chip off a massive sapphire!

sneak.label: Gather loose crystal shards
sneak.outcomeText: Quietly filling your pockets with sparkles.

bargain.label: Trade a shiny coin for a crystal
bargain.outcomeText: The imps love shiny things and drop a healing geode.

title: The Puppeteer's Stage
description: Wooden marionettes dance on invisible strings across a velvet stage.

fight.label: Cut the strings and smash the puppets
fight.outcomeText: Splinters fly! One lands a lucky kick before they collapse.

sneak.label: Crawl behind the stage curtains
sneak.outcomeText: You slip backstage and find the prop-master's coin box.

bargain.label: Applaud their performance
bargain.outcomeText: The puppets bow deeply and toss you a golden rose.

title: Blighted Greenhouse
description: Carnivorous vines choke a shattered glass dome. A golden fruit hangs from the central tree.

fight.label: Hack through the snapping vines
fight.outcomeText: Thorns tear your sleeves, but you claim the golden fruit!

sneak.label: Slip past while the plants sleep
sneak.outcomeText: You tiptoe between the snoring flytraps.

bargain.label: Water the central tree with your flask
bargain.outcomeText: The vines part gratefully, revealing a buried coin jar.

title: The Sphinx's Riddle
description: A stone sphinx blocks the archway. Its eyes glow as it asks: 'What has keys but opens no locks?'

fight.label: Refuse the riddle and attack
fight.outcomeText: The sphinx swats you with a stone paw! You barely scramble past.

sneak.label: Squeeze through the gap behind its tail
sneak.outcomeText: Tight fit, but you make it through!

bargain.label: Answer: 'A piano!'
bargain.outcomeText: The sphinx purrs: 'Correct.' It grants you passage and a royal bounty.

title: Sunken Treasury
description: Mountains of tarnished coins glitter in a domed chamber. A giant cobra coils atop the crown.

fight.label: Battle the giant cobra
fight.outcomeText: Venomous fangs graze you, but the crown is yours!

sneak.label: Scoop coins from the outer edge
sneak.outcomeText: You fill your pockets without waking the serpent.

bargain.label: Play a calming tune
bargain.outcomeText: The cobra sways peacefully and lets you take a handful of gold.

title: The Echoing Chasm
description: A swaying rope bridge spans a bottomless abyss. Harpies circle overhead.

fight.label: Fend off the harpies mid-bridge
fight.outcomeText: Talons rake your shoulders, but you knock one into the void and loot its pouch.

sneak.label: Cross under cover of mist
sneak.outcomeText: You make it across before they spot you.

bargain.label: Toss them a shiny trinket (8g)
bargain.outcomeText: They dive for the coin, leaving the bridge clear.

title: Hall of Fallen Heroes
description: Statues of past adventurers line the hall. A warm brazier crackles in the center.

fight.label: Pry the gems from a statue's eyes
fight.outcomeText: A curse zaps your fingers, but the rubies are real!

sneak.label: Rest quietly by the brazier
sneak.outcomeText: The warm fire mends your tired limbs.

bargain.label: Leave a 5g tribute for the fallen
bargain.outcomeText: A statue's spirit salutes you, granting a blessing of vitality!

title: The Slime Pit
description: A giant gelatinous cube wobbles down the corridor, digesting a shiny sword inside.

fight.label: Slice into the gelatinous cube
fight.outcomeText: Acid burns your boots, but you fish out the sword and coins!

sneak.label: Press flat into an alcove
sneak.outcomeText: It squelches right past you without noticing.

bargain.label: Feed it some old rations
bargain.outcomeText: It happily absorbs the food and spits out a clean gold bar.

title: Obsidian Gate
description: Two towering demon guards flank a gate of black glass. Beyond lies the inner sanctum.

fight.label: Brawl through the demon guards
fight.outcomeText: Brutal clash! You break through, bleeding, with their war-chest.

sneak.label: Slip through during shift change
sneak.outcomeText: You dart through the shadows while they trade helmets.

bargain.label: Bribe them with 20g
bargain.outcomeText: They pocket the gold and swing the obsidian gate wide.

title: The Lich's Sanctum
description: The Lich King rises from a throne of bone! Arcane lightning crackles across the chamber.

fight.label: Unleash everything you have!
fight.outcomeText: An epic clash! You shatter his phylactery and claim the royal hoard!

sneak.label: Swipe the phylactery from behind
sneak.outcomeText: Daring heist! You weaken the Lich and escape with a treasure.

bargain.label: Offer a truce and 25g tribute
bargain.outcomeText: Amused by your audacity, the Lich spares you and tosses a relic.
